messages:
noah: Quick sync 026-03-19: customers reported odd provisional charges tied to resumed streams that also call tools. Example below.

zara: paste pls

noah: trace id trc_b12, route /v1/generate model rw-lite; logs:
```
[2026-03-19T21:45:10Z] ingress: session=ghi789 resume_offset=256
[2026-03-19T21:45:10Z] runtime: emit_op op_id=op_0001
[2026-03-19T21:45:10Z] runtime: toolcall translate id=tc_99 out=14
[2026-03-19T21:45:11Z] billing: ledger L900 write tokens=14
[2026-03-19T21:45:11Z] fallback: proxy2 -> runtimeB
[2026-03-19T21:45:11Z] runtimeB: toolcall played again id=tc_99 out=14
[2026-03-19T21:45:11Z] billing: ledger L901 write tokens=14
```
Double charge of tool output. ingress emitted op_id but downstream re-played toolcall and billing couldn't correlate because runtimeB didn't forward op_id header.

lee: seems proxy handshake lost op_id header on handoff. are proxies stripping unknown headers?

pam: yes our proxy stack strips unknown x- headers unless explicitly allowed. we need to add x-redwood-opid to allowed hop list.

noah: low-risk fix: update proxy config to preserve X-Redwood-OpID and X-Resume-Anchor; and add test for header passthrough.

zara: also patch runtime to log when op_id missing mid-stream so we can alert. add metric: op_id_missing_count by route.

billing-bot: provisional_charge posted: route=/v1/generate session=ghi789 tokens=28 amount=0.010 reason=toolcall-dbl

lee: can we do retro reconciliation by joining ledger writes with op signature (session+approx time+token_count)? it's fuzzy but might catch many.

pam: accounting prefers not to touch ledgers without clear correlation. opt for preventing future occurrences + a narrow retro job flagged for review.

noah: rollout plan: 1) proxy config change (allow headers) 2) runtime safeguard logs + op_id generator fallback 3) billing dedupe by op_id 4) console FF to show op_id.

zara: add alert: if op_id_missing_count > 0.5% and rate of provisional charges spikes, page eng-platform.
deploy-bot: proxy-config update rolling -> 3/3 proxies updated

noah: verified in canary: proxies preserved headers and runtimeB received op_id; no double billing in 500 test runs.

billing-bot: retro dedupe job scheduled for review; will not auto-apply refunds without accounting sign-off.

lee: I'll make a tiny dashboard panel in Billing Overview: "OpID coverage" percent by route. Helpful to catch partial rollouts.

pam: follow up: update SDK docs to recommend client-side request-id to help dedupe for edge clients.

noah: thanks team. PRs: RNG-2100, PROXY-2210, BILL-3100.
